notes.title: v0.2.4 THC Update
notes.content:
Added THC drug samples and associated general, manufacture and usage tasks.
 Various bug fixes and improvements.
 Implemented force grab of smaller objects that are on the floor. 


We've been gradually tweaking to improve performance, so the experience is generally smoother.
